title: Decide: is "Orient" still a domain concept, and is sketch mode now vestigial?
description:
Two product-model decisions surfaced while refreshing docs after the sutra_orient (312) + deviation-report (313) deletions (sutra/317). Both are Josh's calls; deferred because they go beyond mechanical doc cleanup.

1. CONTEXT.md domain model — "Orient" as a core-loop mode.
CONTEXT.md (the canonical domain glossary) still models **Orient** as a live core-loop mode: line 44 ("What Orient points agents at"), the "### Core loop" section (line 140, "**Orient**: Agent asks sutra for context before writing... conventions, boundaries, semantic anchors, cautions, templates"), and line 209 ("**Orient** serves Conventions, Boundaries, Anchors, and templates to agents"). It never names the deleted `sutra_orient` tool — it models Orient as a *concept*. The README core loop was reframed to four beats (explore → check → review → teach, sutra/317 Fork 1), so CONTEXT.md now contradicts the front page.
DECISION NEEDED: drop Orient from the canonical domain model to match the README, OR keep it as an aspirational concept (briefing-before-writing may be re-realized later) with a note. This is why 317 left CONTEXT.md untouched — it's canonical, not a planning doc, so the light-touch banner used for vision docs doesn't fit.

2. Sketch mode (ADR-0001) may now be vestigial for conventions.
Sketch mode's only convention-time effect was marking review deviations `informational` and excluding them from the risk score. Deviations were removed in 313, so that effect no longer has a surface. The `lifecycle_state` column (stable/sketch) is still stored and settable, but nothing reads it for conventions now (verified: only check_inverse's ConventionMatch path + the db getter/setter reference it, and check_inverse has no production caller). Constraints remain enforced regardless of sketch mode.
DECISION NEEDED: is sketch mode (and ADR-0001) now dead and a deletion candidate, or does it stay for a future consumer? Noted as an open question in the rewritten conventions-map.md.

Related: check_inverse / ConventionMatch (deprecated/forbidden pattern matching) also has no production caller now — possible dead-code cleanup in the same sweep.

decisions.decision: Remove Orient from the canonical domain model (CONTEXT.md).
decisions.rationale: The tool was deleted (312) and the README core loop was reframed to four beats without it (317); keeping Orient as a canonical concept contradicts the front page. Josh's call.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Keep Orient as an aspirational concept — rejected; briefing-before-writing is now delivered by contextual surfacing on explore/read, not a distinct mode.

decisions.decision: Remove sketch mode (ADR-0001) AND the dead check_inverse/ConventionMatch path.
decisions.rationale: Sketch mode's only effect was marking review deviations informational; deviations were removed (313), so it is vestigial. check_inverse has no production caller. Josh's call: remove both.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Keep for a future consumer — rejected; no consumer planned.

execution_record:
Josh's calls: (1) remove Orient from the domain model; (2) remove both sketch mode and check_inverse/ConventionMatch. Landed in 2 commits.

CODE (2e5950d): removed ConventionMatch struct, check_inverse fn, 5 tests, and the mod.rs re-export from src/conventions/engine.rs + mod.rs (0 callers, confirmed via sutra_impact); removed component_lifecycle_state + set_component_lifecycle from src/db/components.rs (0 callers); added migration 0060_drop_component_lifecycle.sql to drop the dead components.lifecycle_state column (followed the 0043/0044/0045 schema-cleanup-migration precedent; verify-match default `_ => false` needs no custom arm; migration_count() is derived so no constant bump). cargo build clean, cargo test 1540 passed (down 5 = the removed check_inverse tests); the DROP COLUMN ran in the fresh-DB migration tests.

DOCS (23cd2a2): CONTEXT.md — Core loop Orient beat rewritten to Explore (matches the README four-beat loop from sutra/317); removed the now-unsurfaced Convention-lifecycle glossary entry, Sketch mode entry, and Component-lifecycle section, plus convention-deviation/lifecycle-promotion references (kept the valid component-identity content). conventions-map.md updated for the removals + dropped column. ADR-0001 marked superseded (retained as decision record).

SCOPE HELD: left the convention_overrides table (migration 0007, the deprecated/forbidden/preferred store) in place — it has no reader after this change but removing a table is broader than the instruction; flagged in conventions-map.md as a candidate for a later cleanup migration. Point-in-time docs (docs/brainstorm-constraints.md, docs/prd-core-model.md) still reference sketch/lifecycle and were deliberately not revised; sutra-vision.md is covered by its 317 status banner.

Validated lesson 019f8a3f (demolished FCA mine-persist-lifecycle apparatus) — cited.
